EN:
Sain Motors LLC sells international car brands in Mongolia under official rights from each brand.

We offer JETOUR, CHERY, HONGQI, BYD, AITO, RIDDARA, 212, BESTUNE, MAXUS, RELY and SOUEAST through our showrooms in Ulaanbaatar and Darkhan. Each brand has its own showroom and sales line, and most come with factory warranty and after-sales service. For full model details, visit each brand’s official website.
